title: FHIR
text: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources: a modern HL7 standard for exchanging health data over web APIs.

children.title: Common resources
children.text: Patient, Observation, Condition, MedicationRequest and Encounter cover most clinical data.

children.title: References
children.text: Resources link to each other, for example an Observation points to its Patient.

children.title: Operations
children.text: GET, POST, PUT and DELETE on endpoints like /Patient/123, returning JSON or XML.

children.title: Search
children.text: Query parameters filter results, e.g. Observation?patient=123&code=8867-4.

children.title: Profiles
children.text: Implementation guides constrain resources for a country or use case, such as US Core.

children.title: SMART on FHIR
children.text: An OAuth-based framework letting apps launch securely inside EHRs.
